Describing a Lost Item in German: A2 Phrase Practice

Describe a missing item and ask where to check in German. Practise verloren, aussehen and clear object details with explained answers.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Useful phrases and patterns

A useful lost-item description names the object, a visible detail and where you last saw it. Ich habe … verloren reports the loss. Es ist … or Es sieht … aus adds a description. Ask Haben Sie etwas gefunden? or Wo kann ich nachfragen? to continue the conversation.

Common mistake to avoid

Lost and stolen are different claims. Verloren describes a loss; do not replace it with gestohlen without a reason to make that stronger claim.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice what the speaker wants to do, the level of politeness and the details the listener needs.

Worked example 1Ich habe einen dunkelblauen Regenschirm verloren.I have lost a dark blue umbrella.
Worked example 2Am Griff hängt ein kleines gelbes Band.A small yellow ribbon hangs from the handle.
Worked example 3Zuletzt hatte ich ihn im Lesesaal bei mir.I last had it with me in the reading room.
Worked example 4Wo kann ich fragen, ob jemand ihn gefunden hat?Where can I ask whether someone has found it?

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete each lost-item phrase with the word or verb in brackets. Use only the fictional description supplied. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: gefunden · nachfragen · sieht · verloren

Question 1. Ich habe meine Stofftasche ___. (verlieren, Partizip II)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: verloren

The perfect form is habe ... verloren.

Question 2. Die Tasche ___ grau aus. (aussehen, finite stem)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: sieht

Aussehen separates into sieht ... aus.

Question 3. Haben Sie hier einen Schlüssel ___? (finden, Partizip II)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: gefunden

The participle of finden is gefunden.

Question 4. Wo kann ich danach ___? (ask, nachfragen)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: nachfragen

Nachfragen is the infinitive after kann.

Use it in your own sentence

Describe a lost black backpack containing a notebook.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich suche einen schwarzen Rucksack. Darin liegt ein blaues Notizheft.

Check your wording: Give distinguishing details instead of only saying that something is missing.

What to practise next

Adapt a model to a different listener or situation. Keep the request, time reference and formal or informal address consistent.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
